assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate, raising clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia.
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered for continuous rhythm monitoring.
The service is supported by diagnosis codes I47.1 and R00.2.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The provider may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of this notice.
